_instructions: Gate G2.b fixture template. Copy to g2b-observations.json and fill in
from the OFFICIAL web client, one entry per kami, ≥ 10 kamis spanning
Per observation: kamiIndex = the kami's on-chain index; blockHeight =
the chain head at the moment of reading (must be at/after the local
mirror snapshot block and within RPC retention, ~25 days);
wallTimestampMs = epoch ms on the observing machine at the moment of
reading (the same clock the web client renders with); stateLabel as
displayed; displayedHP to the integer; displayedMusu to the floor;
displayedCooldownSec remaining cooldown in whole seconds (0 if none).
The observations are data; the verdict is b-display-parity.mts's exit
